purpose: Index four declared temporal evolution laws by semantic role without executing any law.

required.statement: Accept exactly four distinct source-backed law roles and preserve role, law kind, identity, opaque expression, trace, eight unresolved identifiers, and TLC-EA-HUIT-005-001.
Return an immutable deterministic four-entry DimensionDynamicsCatalogue.

forbidden.statement: Do not integrate, sample, solve, simulate, simplify, coerce, or numerically evaluate any law.
Do not omit, add, duplicate, alias, merge, or mutate role-keyed entries.

deferred.statement: Scientific types, signatures, units, order, aggregation, numerics, oracle semantics, boundary, solver, time domain, precision, and stochastic semantics remain unresolved.
Concrete runtime representation and resource policy remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Validate and construct the exact role-keyed opaque law catalogue.

inputs.name: law_descriptors
inputs.semantic_role: exact semantic-role map of opaque law declarations

constraints.statement: The four scientific object identifiers are distinct and input map order has no semantic effect.
Exactly four entries preserve law kind, source identity, source trace, and opaque expression bytes.

preconditions.statement: All four exact roles, distinct identifiers, traces, reservations, and assumption are present.
No solver, sampling, integration, or execution option is requested.

postconditions.statement: The catalogue contains exactly four entries under the declared semantic role keys.
No differential or stochastic law is executed and all propagated sets remain exact.

invariants.statement: Source object identities, law classifications, source statements, and opaque payloads remain unchanged.
The limited engineering status and absence of persistent or external effects remain explicit.

steps: validate exact roles identities and traceability

partial_order.before: validate exact roles identities and traceability

prescription_basis: Observable role validation and preservation constrain publication; no solver or unique total construction strategy is prescribed.

error_contract.condition: Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-005-MISSING-TRACE: a required role, identifier, trace, reservation, or assumption is missing.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-005-OPERATION: a role is duplicate or missing, a law identity is absent, or execution is requested.
Schema-compatible public alias for authoritative source error FAIL-HUIT-005-SCIENTIFIC-INVENTION: unstated scientific, numeric, stochastic, temporal, or algorithmic semantics are supplied.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the exact four preserved role-keyed law declarations and stable errors.
Do not solve, integrate, sample, or simulate any law.
Internal architecture is free when observable obligations are satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: Role cardinality, identity, law kind, opacity, unresolved propagation, immutability, and provenance cannot be weakened.
Unresolved scientific execution never becomes a default solver or numerical process.

notes: Conformance is structural and does not authorize law execution or prescribe a language, serialization, or total internal algorithm.
